summary: GRAVITY Co., Ltd., a South Korean game developer listed on Nasdaq (GRVY), filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution on August 7, 2026 to pay an interim cash dividend for fiscal 2026. The dividend is KRW 4,400 per share, with a record date of June 30, 2026, and payment on September 2, 2026. The total cash dividend amounts to KRW 30,575,160,000. This is a routine capital return to shareholders, announced outside a merger or restructuring context. The filing does not provide other deal terms. Watch for potential future dividend policy changes as a sign of ongoing capital return strategy.
